rejected_claims.reason: RD-4(a) exemption fails: the vehicle-breakdown incident [F11] is a single-point left-lane blockage that does not justify the substituted stretch of the optimal route, over which the driver covered 3.98 km reaching 995 m off-route [F3]; speed bands alone do not exempt under RD-4(b) [F9][F10], so an unexempt segment exists and RD-2 yields a positive amount, not no_action.

Speed band 4 (30–39 km/h) [F9][F10] does not meet RD-4(b)'s band 1/2 congestion threshold and cannot exempt a segment on its own; it corroborates slowdown only, and does not establish the reasonable cause RD-4(a) requires.

The billed excess of $3.33 (2.4 km × $1.41/km) [F4] cannot be treated as mapping onto an exempt segment: the registered segment [F3] is unexempt, so the mileage component of 2.11 km at the trip rate $1.41/km [F6] is refundable under RD-2, i.e. $2.98, not zero.
